description: Creates a stable private download of a saved board as a manufacturing ZIP or editable .egb project backup. Read get_board for expectedRevision. Use format egb directly for project backups, including empty or incomplete projects and unapplied geometry or electrical changes; no layout generation or check is required. Manufacturing ZIPs require a current saved layout with applied electrical requirements; generate and wait for completion when needed, then read the new revision. Inherited licensing requires changeNote. New exports require current board access. Issued download links have no automatic expiry and retain this exact export after board edits, deletion, guest claim or cleanup. Only explicit download-link revocation or deletion of the exported file ends access. Keep each complete private URL unchanged, including its fragment; anyone with it can download the file. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

boardId.description: Accessible saved board ID from get_board, create_board, or list_boards.

changeNote.description: Description of modifications, required when get_board returns inherited licensing. Added to the exported license notices.

expectedRevision.description: Revision from get_board. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before exporting.

format.description: manufacturing: ZIP with Gerber, drill, BOM and placement files. egb: editable EasyGerber board file.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

name: export_board
title: Export board files
